items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: We were all in Oliver Todd's band. ... Piggy Minor ... Earl Jackson ... William Scott.

ctx.x: In fact, I was instrumental in bringing all the rest of them into Max Hand's (phonetic) band. McShann
We had Piggy Minor (phonetic) on trumpet, Earl Jackson --that's not John Jackson, now. Earl Jackson became before John Jackson, you know.
